findings.description: Priority 1 recommendation – "Give every custom control an accessible name and the correct role…" is generic, lacking a specific selector or page reference from this audit.
Priority 2 recommendation – "Raise the contrast ratio of the flagged text…" is generic, not anchored to any specific element or count.
Priority 3 recommendation – "Make every id attribute unique within each page…" is generic and not tied to a particular ID instance from the audit data.
Priority 4 recommendation – "Add descriptive alt text to every informative image…" lacks a specific image selector or URL reference.
Priority 5 recommendation – "Expose the structure a sighted user sees…" is generic, with no data anchor such as a CSS selector or page count.
Priority 6 recommendation – "Add a skip link as the first focusable element…" does not reference a specific location or element from the audit findings.
Priority 7 recommendation – "Order headings without skipping levels…" is generic, lacking a page‑specific context or selector.

Priority 8 recommendation – "Replace the obvious landmark containers (header, nav, main, footer, aside) with their semantic elements…" is not anchored to any specific element instance from this audit.
Priority 9 recommendation – "Profile the slow route with server‑side tooling…" is generic and does not cite a particular page or metric from the audit data.

Priority 11 recommendation – "Complete the flagged SEO metadata (title, meta description, canonical) so search engines index the page…" is generic; it references missing SEO fields but no specific URL or count.
Priority 12 recommendation – "Add the missing required and recommended Schema.org properties to the flagged entity types…" lacks a specific schema instance or property reference from this audit.
Priority 13 recommendation – identical to Priority 12, generic and not anchored to any particular entity or page.
